Contract LoanProcessingSystemSystem::closeOutLoan(loanid:Integer): Boolean {
          definition:
          loan:Loan = Loan.allInstance()->any(l | l.LoanID = loanid)
            
            precondition:
          Loan.allInstance()->includes(loan) and loan.Status = LoanStatus::LSOPEN
            
            postcondition:
          let result in if not loan.oclIsUndefined() then loan.Status = LoanStatus::CLOSED else false endif
            
        }
